names.legendary: Bouncealot the Unstoppable

lore.common: Rolls straight into the drain the moment someone kicks it gently.
lore.uncommon: Disappears into the same hedge every single game.
lore.rare: Bounces off the path at an angle no physics teacher can explain.
lore.epic: Bounced off the shed, the car and the greenhouse in one kick, and the whole street came out.
lore.legendary: Was kicked so high that it landed on the school roof and is still the school's most famous ball.

names.legendary: Zingo the Ball Who Never Stopped

lore.common: Bops the ceiling light every time it's dropped on the kitchen floor.
lore.uncommon: Always ends up under the fridge with the dust and lost peas.
lore.rare: Bounces higher every time, as if it's getting angrier.
lore.epic: Ricocheted round the kitchen so fast that everyone ducked behind the table.
lore.legendary: Was dropped from a tower and bounced back up to the top floor, where it waited politely.

names.legendary: The Ball That Answered Everything

lore.common: Always says ask again later when you need an answer right now.
lore.uncommon: Shows its answer in a cloudy bubble that takes ages to float up.
lore.rare: Gives answers so spooky that the whole sleepover goes quiet.
lore.epic: Was asked a hundred questions at the sleepover, and everyone screamed at every yes.
lore.legendary: Said yes to the question will it snow tomorrow, and the next day there was a snowman on every lawn.

names.legendary: The Marble That Won Every Game

lore.common: Rolls across the floor at night and wakes the whole house.
lore.uncommon: Gets lost under the skirting board the moment the game starts.
lore.rare: Has a swirl of colour inside that looks like a tiny galaxy.
lore.epic: Escaped the marble run and rolled down the whole school corridor.
lore.legendary: Won every playground game for a whole year, and the other marbles were too scared to play.

names.legendary: The Ball That Calmed the Office

lore.common: Gets squeezed so hard that it looks like it's pulling a face.
lore.uncommon: Has a funny face that squishes up when you squeeze it.
lore.rare: Calms down anyone who's about to shout.
lore.epic: Was squeezed by every pupil during exam week, and half of them burst.
lore.legendary: Calmed a whole office on deadline day, and nobody shouted once.

names.legendary: The Balloon That Crossed the Sea

lore.common: Floats up to the ceiling so the string is just out of reach.
lore.uncommon: Pops with a bang that makes everyone at the party scream.
lore.rare: Escapes from tiny hands and sails off over the rooftops.
lore.epic: Escaped from the party with fifty others, and the sky over the village went colourful.
lore.legendary: Floated across the whole sea and landed in another country with its party message still attached.

names.legendary: The Confetti Found a Year Later

lore.common: Ends up in every corner of the house for months.
lore.uncommon: Hides in your hair long after the party is over.
lore.rare: Clogs the vacuum cleaner so badly that it gives up.
lore.epic: Was thrown at the wedding, and the whole street sparkled for a week.
lore.legendary: Was still being found in shoes, pockets and books a whole year after the party.

names.legendary: The Bat That Hit the Ball Over the Wall

lore.common: Swings with all its might and hits nothing but air.
lore.uncommon: Gives a splinter to anyone holding it wrong.
lore.rare: Hits the ball so far that the fielders give up running.
lore.epic: Smashed a ball over the park fence and into the duck pond, and the ducks were furious.
lore.legendary: Hit a ball so far that it landed in the next town's park and won their game too.

names.legendary: The Ball That Made Every Shot

lore.common: Spins round the rim and pops back out every time.
lore.uncommon: Bounces so loudly in the hallway that the neighbours bang on the ceiling.
lore.rare: Bangs off the backboard so hard that the whole hoop shakes.
lore.epic: Was slam-dunked so hard that the playground hoop bent down like a bow.
lore.legendary: Went in from the other end of the court in the last second of the final.

names.legendary: The Book That Was Coloured Perfectly

lore.common: Gets coloured outside every line.
lore.uncommon: Has a crayon snapped in its spine from the last time.
lore.rare: Is always half finished, with every page started and none done.
lore.epic: Was coloured by the whole class on a rainy day, and every page was a different rainbow.
lore.legendary: Was coloured so perfectly by one patient child that it was framed in the school hall.

names.legendary: The Bottle That Got the Baby to Sleep

lore.common: Dribbles milk down the baby's chin every time.
lore.uncommon: Gets thrown out of the pram onto the pavement.
lore.rare: Is needed at three in the morning, every morning.
lore.epic: Was warmed up at the same time as every bottle at the toddler group, and the room was quiet at last.
lore.legendary: Got a baby to sleep through the whole night for the first time, and the parents nearly cried.

names.legendary: The Bottle That Never Leaked

lore.common: Squirts water up your nose when you squeeze it too hard.
lore.uncommon: Has its lid chewed by its owner during every match.
lore.rare: Leaks into the bottom of the school bag every single day.
lore.epic: Squirted every player on the team at half-time, and the coach got soaked too.
lore.legendary: Was carried to every match for ten years and never leaked once.

names.legendary: The Box That Had Every Colour

lore.common: Has every crayon snapped in half within a week.
lore.uncommon: Is always missing the one colour you need.
lore.rare: Leaves waxy colours on your hands and the table.
lore.epic: Was used on the bedroom wall by a toddler, and the wall became a rainbow.
lore.legendary: Had every colour in the world in it, including one nobody had a name for.

names.legendary: The Clown That Popped Out for a Century

lore.common: Pops out so suddenly that everyone drops what they're holding.
lore.uncommon: Needs winding round and round while it plays a tune.
lore.rare: Grins out of its box so widely that the cat runs away.
lore.epic: Popped out in the middle of the birthday party, and the whole room screamed then laughed.
lore.legendary: Has popped out of the same box for a hundred years and still makes grandad jump.

names.legendary: The Box That Sent Every Baby to Sleep

lore.common: Plays the same tune over and over until everyone is humming it.
lore.uncommon: Has to be wound up every five minutes.
lore.rare: Plays a lullaby so gentle that the cat falls asleep too.
lore.epic: Played its lullaby at the nursery, and every baby fell asleep at once.
lore.legendary: Has sent three generations of babies to sleep with the same tune.

names.legendary: The Bucket That Built a Castle Town

lore.common: Tips its sand out before the castle is finished.
lore.uncommon: Catches crabs that pinch everyone who looks inside.
lore.rare: Makes perfect castle towers every single time.
lore.epic: Was filled with the whole beach's best shells, and the shell collectors followed it home.
lore.legendary: Built a sandcastle so big that the lifeguard climbed it to watch the sea.

names.legendary: The Pinwheel That Never Stopped Spinning

lore.common: Stops dead the moment you stop running, and refuses to spin standing still.
lore.uncommon: Gets stuck when it's not facing the wind, so you have to blow on it.
lore.rare: Spins so fast that it hums.
lore.epic: Spun with a hundred others on the seaside garden, and the whole beach whirred.
lore.legendary: Spun for a whole summer on the windowsill without stopping once.

names.legendary: The Controller That Won the Final

lore.common: Gets its buttons mashed so hard that they stick.
lore.uncommon: Has a stick that drifts to the left on its own.
lore.rare: Wraps its wire round everyone's ankles.
lore.epic: Was passed round the whole sleepover until sunrise, and the batteries gave up first.
lore.legendary: Won the final of a game tournament with the last button press.

names.legendary: The Console of a Thousand Journeys

lore.common: Runs out of battery just before the final level.
lore.uncommon: Has a cracked screen corner that its owner insists makes it look cooler.
lore.rare: Makes a long car journey feel like five minutes.
lore.epic: Kept the whole back seat quiet on a ten-hour drive.
lore.legendary: Survived a thousand car journeys, two drops in a puddle and one trip through the washing machine.

names.legendary: The Band That Soaked a Whole Match

lore.common: Soaks up so much sweat that it drips.
lore.uncommon: Makes everyone who wears it look like a tennis star.
lore.rare: Looks so old-fashioned that everyone thinks it's a costume.
lore.epic: Soaked up the sweat of every player at the tennis club on the hottest day.
lore.legendary: Soaked up a whole five-hour tennis match without dripping once.

names.legendary: The Wig That Fooled the Whole Family

lore.common: Itches so much that its wearer scratches all evening.
lore.uncommon: Slides off sideways when its wearer nods.
lore.rare: Changes its wearer's whole personality, so every pirate wig produces a very loud pirate.
lore.epic: Was swapped between every guest at the costume party, and nobody knew who was who.
lore.legendary: Fooled a whole family into thinking grandma had a new haircut for a week.

names.legendary: The Pinata That Rained Sweets

lore.common: Refuses to break no matter how many times it's hit.
lore.uncommon: Swings away from the stick at the last second.
lore.rare: Bursts open with sweets that rain down on everyone.
lore.epic: Burst at the birthday party and showered sweets over the whole garden.
lore.legendary: Survived a hundred hits at one party before finally showering the whole street with sweets.

names.legendary: The Horse That Rocked Four Generations

lore.common: Squeaks on every rock so the whole house knows it's being ridden.
lore.uncommon: Pinches fingers under its rockers.
lore.rare: Rocks so fast that its rider thinks they're galloping across a field.
lore.epic: Rocked so hard in the nursery that it crossed the room and bumped the door.
lore.legendary: Has been rocked by four generations of children in the same family.

names.legendary: The Mask That Hid the Mayor

lore.common: Slips so the eye holes end up on your cheeks.
lore.uncommon: Has a face so scary that the cat hides under the bed.
lore.rare: Hides its wearer so well that nobody recognises them, not even their mum.
lore.epic: Was worn by everyone in the street parade, and the whole town felt like a festival.
lore.legendary: Hid the mayor so well at the town party that nobody knew he'd joined the conga line.

names.legendary: The Dough That Became a Zoo

lore.common: Gets ground into the carpet and never comes out.
lore.uncommon: Mixes every colour into one brownish lump.
lore.rare: Gets tasted by every toddler, who find it very salty.
lore.epic: Was made into a whole zoo by the playgroup, with a giraffe and three wonky elephants.
lore.legendary: Made a model so good that it was put in a glass case at the library.

names.legendary: The Kite That Touched the Clouds

lore.common: Gets tangled in the only tree on the whole beach.
lore.uncommon: Nosedives into the sand the moment it gets going.
lore.rare: Flies so high that it's just a speck in the sky.
lore.epic: Flew with a hundred others at the kite festival, and the sky was full of dragons.
lore.legendary: Flew so high that a passing plane's pilot waved at it.

names.legendary: The Dinosaur Who Survived the Wash

lore.common: Stabs your bare foot with its spiky tail in the dark.
lore.uncommon: Has a wobbly head that nods yes to every question it's asked.
lore.rare: Gets buried in the sandpit and dug up as a fossil.
lore.epic: Led a stampede of plastic dinosaurs across the playroom that knocked over the castle.
lore.legendary: Survived a trip through the washing machine and came out roaring louder than before.

names.legendary: The Kitchen of the Finest Plastic Cake

lore.common: Gets plastic peas served to everyone who walks past.
lore.uncommon: Has plastic food that ends up everywhere in the house.
lore.rare: Serves tea to every teddy in the room at once.
lore.epic: Opened a restaurant in the playroom, and every grown-up had to order dinner.
lore.legendary: Served a plastic cake so convincing that grandad tried to eat it.

names.legendary: The Pig That Saved for a Bicycle

lore.common: Rattles loudly every time it's picked up.
lore.uncommon: Has a cork in its tummy that nobody is allowed to pull out until the summer holidays.
lore.rare: Has no hole in the bottom, so the only way to get coins out is a lot of patient shaking.
lore.epic: Was shaken by every child at the party, and the floor was covered in coins.
lore.legendary: Saved up enough coins over five years for its owner to buy a brand-new bicycle.

names.legendary: The Table Where the Rally Never Ended

lore.common: Clips every ball on the net so it dribbles over.
lore.uncommon: Folds up so suddenly that it traps the bats inside.
lore.rare: Puts a spin on every bounce that nobody can return.
lore.epic: Held a garage tournament that lasted all weekend, and the parents brought sandwiches.
lore.legendary: Hosted a rally so long that both players had to have tea in the middle of it.

names.legendary: The Tower That Touched the Ceiling

lore.common: Topples the moment the last block goes on top.
lore.uncommon: Has corners that dig into your knees when you kneel on them.
lore.rare: Grows taller than the toddler building it.
lore.epic: Crashed down from the top of the tower, and every block scattered across the playroom.
lore.legendary: Was stacked into a tower so tall that it touched the ceiling, and nobody dared breathe.

names.legendary: The Checker That Was Crowned Twice

lore.common: Jumps over three pieces at once and makes its opponent groan.
lore.uncommon: Loses a piece under the sofa, so one is always a bottle cap.
lore.rare: Gets crowned so often that it needs its own tiny cushion.
lore.epic: Was played on every park bench in the square, and the pigeons watched every move.
lore.legendary: Won a game against a grandad who had never lost in fifty years.

names.legendary: The Board That Hosted the Longest Game

lore.common: Makes everyone sit in silence for hours.
lore.uncommon: Gets knocked over by the cat just before the final move.
lore.rare: Pulls a face on whoever loses.
lore.epic: Hosted the chess club's final in such silence that the clock ticking was the loudest thing in town.
lore.legendary: Hosted a game so long that it was finished by the grandchildren of the people who started it.

names.legendary: The Dice That Rolled a Hundred Sixes

lore.common: Shows a different number every time someone else checks it.
lore.uncommon: Never rolls a six when you need one.
lore.rare: Rolls a double just when everyone's about to lose.
lore.epic: Rolled so badly in the board game that the whole family argued until bedtime.
lore.legendary: Rolled a hundred sixes in a row, and the family checked it for magic.

names.legendary: The Domino Run That Filled the Hall

lore.common: Topples over before the run is finished, and the whole lot falls.
lore.uncommon: Has spots that everyone counts to make sure they match.
lore.rare: Links into a chain that curves round the whole room.
lore.epic: Fell in a chain round the whole school hall, and the class cheered at the end.
lore.legendary: Toppled in a run so long that it went from the kitchen to the bottom of the garden.

names.legendary: The Puzzle With No Missing Pieces

lore.common: Is always missing one piece, found months later under the rug.
lore.uncommon: Gets its edges done first by everyone, then left.
lore.rare: Has a sky so blue that every piece looks the same.
lore.epic: Took the whole family a rainy weekend to finish, and they cheered at the last piece.
lore.legendary: Was finished with every single piece, which no family puzzle has ever managed.

names.legendary: The Brick That Built a Castle

lore.common: Stabs every bare foot that walks across the bedroom at night.
lore.uncommon: Snaps onto another brick so tightly that teeth are needed to get it off.
lore.rare: Builds anything you can imagine, including a spaceship for the hamster.
lore.epic: Built a whole city on the living room floor, and nobody could walk across it for a week.
lore.legendary: Built a castle so big that the family cat moved into the tallest tower.

names.legendary: The Cube Solved in Seconds

lore.common: Gets twisted for hours and ends up more mixed than before.
lore.uncommon: Has its stickers peeled off and moved by people who give up.
lore.rare: Gets solved in seconds by one kid in every class.
lore.epic: Was twisted by every pupil in the school during the cube craze, and the playground clicked.
lore.legendary: Was solved blindfolded by a girl who then did it with one hand.

names.legendary: The Racket That Won the Summer

lore.common: Snaps a string on the first hit of the season.
lore.uncommon: Hits the ball with its frame and sends it over the fence.
lore.rare: Smashes the ball so hard that the opponent ducks.
lore.epic: Smashed every ball at the summer tournament, and the court ran out of balls.
lore.legendary: Won every match of the summer, and its owner slept with it under the pillow.

names.legendary: The Robot That Learned to Dance

lore.common: Beeps as it walks into the wall and keeps walking.
lore.uncommon: Runs out of battery halfway across the room.
lore.rare: Swings its arms so wildly that it knocks over the drinks.
lore.epic: Marched across the living room with every toy robot in the house, and the cat fled.
lore.legendary: Learned to dance so well that it was the star of the school talent show.

names.legendary: The Robot Dog That Fooled the Cat

lore.common: Barks a tinny bark that sets the real dog barking too.
lore.uncommon: Wags its plastic tail at everyone.
lore.rare: Fetches the ball and then forgets to bring it back.
lore.epic: Entered the dog show with real dogs, and the judges were very confused.
lore.legendary: Was taken for a walk round the whole park on a lead, and three real dogs tried to make friends.

names.legendary: The Toy That Walked Across the Table

lore.common: Walks straight off the edge of the table.
lore.uncommon: Has a key that needs twisting until your fingers hurt.
lore.rare: Clicks and whirrs across the floor like a little machine.
lore.epic: Raced every wind-up toy in the house across the kitchen floor, and the cat chased them all.
lore.legendary: Walked across the whole dining table without falling off, which no wind-up toy has ever done.

names.legendary: The Boat That Sailed Across the Lake

lore.common: Sinks in the bath the moment it's loaded with soap.
lore.uncommon: Sails across the park pond pulled on a string.
lore.rare: Drifts away from the shore and has to be rescued with a stick.
lore.epic: Raced every toy boat on the park pond, and the ducks joined in.
lore.legendary: Sailed across the whole lake on its own and was found on the far side by a fisherman.

names.legendary: The Board That Landed the Trick

lore.common: Shoots out from under its rider and hits them in the shin.
lore.uncommon: Fails every kickflip but looks cool trying.
lore.rare: Flies off the ramp so high that the crowd gasps.
lore.epic: Rolled through the skate park with every board in town, and the ramps rumbled.
lore.legendary: Landed a trick that nobody had ever done, and the skate park named it after the board.

names.legendary: The Flippers That Raced the Turtle

lore.common: Makes everyone walk like a duck on the beach.
lore.uncommon: Drags along the bottom of the pool when its swimmer stops.
lore.rare: Makes its swimmer zoom through the water like a fish.
lore.epic: Flapped across the bay with every snorkeller on the holiday, and the fish moved aside.
lore.legendary: Raced a sea turtle across the lagoon and came a close second.

names.legendary: The Ball That Scored the Winning Goal

lore.common: Bursts the goal net on every big shot.
lore.uncommon: Comes home so muddy that it has to be washed in the bath.
lore.rare: Swerves away from the goalkeeper's gloves at the very last second, as if it has a mind of its own.
lore.epic: Was kicked in the park final for so long that the floodlights came on.
lore.legendary: Scored the winning goal in the cup final from the halfway line.

names.legendary: The Pads That Saved Every Elbow

lore.common: Gets sweaty and smelly after the first ride.
lore.uncommon: Slides down to the wrist when its owner is riding.
lore.rare: Saves every elbow from scrapes on the playground.
lore.epic: Saved every elbow at the skate park on the busiest day.
lore.legendary: Saved its owner's elbows from a thousand tumbles.

names.legendary: The Pads That Took a Thousand Falls

lore.common: Squeaks every time its wearer kneels.
lore.uncommon: Has straps that slip until the pads sit on the ankles.
lore.rare: Makes every fall feel like a soft bump.
lore.epic: Saved every knee at the roller rink on the first day of the holidays.
lore.legendary: Took a thousand falls without a single scraped knee.

names.legendary: The Guard That Stopped Every Kick

lore.common: Slips down inside the sock during the match.
lore.uncommon: Gets so sweaty that it smells after one game.
lore.rare: Stops every kick from reaching the shin.
lore.epic: Took every kick in the football tournament, and its player didn't feel a thing.
lore.legendary: Stopped a kick from the hardest kicker in the league and didn't even crack.

names.legendary: The Tea Set That Hosted Every Teddy

lore.common: Has cups so tiny that only teddies can drink from them.
lore.uncommon: Hosts every teddy in the house for tea.
lore.rare: Pours pretend tea that somehow spills on the carpet.
lore.epic: Hosted a tea party for every teddy in the street, and the garden was full of bears.
lore.legendary: Has served pretend tea to four generations of teddies in the same family.

names.legendary: The Ball That Was Fetched Forever

lore.common: Gets chewed by every dog until it's soggy.
lore.uncommon: Loses its fuzz after one game.
lore.rare: Ends up on the roof of every house it's thrown near.
lore.epic: Was thrown at the dog park, and every dog chased it at once.
lore.legendary: Has been fetched by the same dog ten thousand times and is now mostly drool.

names.legendary: The Pawn That Became a Queen

lore.common: Goes missing just as the game is about to start.
lore.uncommon: Jumps in an L-shape that confuses everyone.
lore.rare: Marches all the way across the board and becomes a queen.
lore.epic: Went missing from every chess set in the school, and the chess club used buttons.
lore.legendary: Marched from one end of the board to the other in the final and won the game.

names.legendary: The Horn That Started the Party

lore.common: Unrolls with a toot right into the next person's face.
lore.uncommon: Toots so loudly that everyone jumps.
lore.rare: Squeals in a high pitch that sets every dog barking.
lore.epic: Was blown by every guest at the countdown, and the street sounded like a flock of geese.
lore.legendary: Started a party so loud that the whole street joined in.

names.legendary: The Doll That Was Loved Bald

lore.common: Gets fed a pretend bottle every five minutes.
lore.uncommon: Cries when you press its tummy, usually at the dinner table.
lore.rare: Gets pushed round the house in its own pram.
lore.epic: Was taken to the doll hospital at playgroup, and every doll got a bandage.
lore.legendary: Was loved so much over twenty years that it lost all its hair.

names.legendary: The Ball That Escaped the Pit

lore.common: Gets stuffed down every child's sock.
lore.uncommon: Escapes the ball pit and ends up under the café table.
lore.rare: Comes in so many colours that the pit looks like a rainbow.
lore.epic: Was thrown up in the air by every child at once, and the soft play turned into a ball storm.
lore.legendary: Escaped the ball pit, rolled out of the soft play and was found in the car park.

names.legendary: The Doll With a Thousand Outfits

lore.common: Loses one tiny shoe the moment it's put on.
lore.uncommon: Gets its hair brushed until it's frizzy.
lore.rare: Changes outfits ten times a day.
lore.epic: Held a fashion show with every doll in the house, and the catwalk was the dining table.
lore.legendary: Has a thousand outfits and still only wears the same one.

names.legendary: The Hoop That Saw a Thousand Baskets

lore.common: Rattles so loudly when the ball hits the rim that the neighbours complain.
lore.uncommon: Has a net that hangs by one thread.
lore.rare: Stands on the driveway so the car has to park round it.
lore.epic: Hosted a shootout that went on until the street lights came on.
lore.legendary: Saw a thousand baskets in one summer of practice.

names.legendary: The Boomerang That Came Home

lore.common: Never comes back when you throw it, only when you've given up.
lore.uncommon: Lands in the only tree in the whole park.
lore.rare: Swoops round in a perfect circle and lands right at its thrower's feet.
lore.epic: Looped round the whole park and knocked the hat off a very surprised gardener.
lore.legendary: Was thrown on holiday and came back a week later through the letterbox.

names.legendary: The Ball That Bowled a Perfect Game

lore.common: Rolls straight into the gutter on every first try.
lore.uncommon: Gets its holes stuck on fingers so it's hard to let go.
lore.rare: Rolls down the lane with a rumble like thunder.
lore.epic: Knocked down every pin on every lane at the birthday party, and the alley went wild.
lore.legendary: Bowled a perfect game, and the bowling alley framed it.

names.legendary: The Wand That Bubbled the House

lore.common: Spills its soapy mix down your arm.
lore.uncommon: Pops its bubbles before they leave the wand.
lore.rare: Blows a bubble so big that a child could fit inside it.
lore.epic: Filled the whole garden with bubbles, and every child chased them till dark.
lore.legendary: Blew a bubble so big that it floated over the house and popped on the chimney.

names.legendary: The Ball Hit Over the Pavilion

lore.common: Is so hard and red that everyone ducks when it comes near.
lore.uncommon: Gets polished on the bowler's trousers until they're red.
lore.rare: Bowls so fast that the batter only hears it go past.
lore.epic: Was hit for six on the village green and landed in the tea tent.
lore.legendary: Was hit over the pavilion roof and landed in a passing lorry, never to be seen again.

names.legendary: The Ball That Nobody Could Dodge

lore.common: Finds everyone's head, even when they duck.
lore.uncommon: Slaps the gym wall with a crack that echoes.
lore.rare: Curves round everyone who tries to dodge it.
lore.epic: Turned the PE lesson into a showdown that lasted until the bell.
lore.legendary: Hit every player on the other team in one throw.

names.legendary: The House Where the Dolls Held a Wedding

lore.common: Has furniture so tiny that it gets lost under the rug.
lore.uncommon: Opens its whole front like a cupboard.
lore.rare: Holds a whole tiny world where every doll has a bedroom.
lore.epic: Hosted a party for every doll in the house, and the kitchen was full of tiny cakes.
lore.legendary: Hosted a doll wedding so grand that the family took photos for the album.

names.legendary: The Ball That Bounced the Office

lore.common: Rolls away the moment someone stands up.
lore.uncommon: Gets used as a chair that bounces you up and down.
lore.rare: Wobbles its sitter until they fall off sideways.
lore.epic: Bounced around the living room so wildly that the lamp fell over.
lore.legendary: Replaced every office chair for a week, and the whole office bounced to work.

names.legendary: The Ball That Won the Final

lore.common: Is gripped so tightly that its players' hands go red.
lore.uncommon: Thunders into the goal with a smack.
lore.rare: Bounces off the wall at angles that surprise everyone.
lore.epic: Was thrown so hard in the final that the goal net shook.
lore.legendary: Won the final with a throw from the other end of the court.

names.legendary: The Tube of Endless Patterns

lore.common: Makes everyone dizzy after one twist.
lore.uncommon: Changes its pattern with every twist.
lore.rare: Shows patterns so beautiful that people forget what they were doing.
lore.epic: Was passed round the whole class, and nobody wanted to give it back.
lore.legendary: Showed a different pattern every time for fifty years, and never the same one twice.

names.legendary: The Little Figure Who Saved Brick Town

lore.common: Pops its head off whenever it's dropped.
lore.uncommon: Swaps hair with every other figure in the box.
lore.rare: Loses its tiny hat under the sofa forever.
lore.epic: Led every figure in the box on an adventure across the whole living room.
lore.legendary: Saved a whole brick town from a toy dinosaur, according to its owner.

names.legendary: The Puppet That Danced Without Strings

lore.common: Tangles its strings into a knot before every show.
lore.uncommon: Dances with floppy legs that make everyone laugh.
lore.rare: Performs so well that the audience forgets about the strings.
lore.epic: Performed at the puppet theatre, and the children wouldn't let it stop.
lore.legendary: It once took a bow, cut its own strings with a curtsey and carried on dancing for an encore.

names.legendary: The Ball That Shook the Gym

lore.common: Thuds onto the floor so hard that the windows rattle.
lore.uncommon: It sits in the corner of the gym, daring anyone to pick it up, and only the caretaker ever does.
lore.rare: Makes everyone who throws it grunt like a weightlifter.
lore.epic: Was thrown across the gym by every player at once, and the floor shook.
lore.legendary: Was thrown so hard that it bounced out of the gym and down the corridor.

names.legendary: The Mobile That Sang Six Babies Asleep

lore.common: It hangs over the cot and turns slowly, keeping one painted moon facing the door like a lookout.
lore.uncommon: It plays the same tiny tune each night and has quietly decided it is the best song ever written.
lore.rare: Its dangling stars drift into a pattern so soothing that anyone watching forgets why they came in.
lore.epic: Wound up once, it turned for a whole night and sent a toddler, two cats and a grandad to sleep.
lore.legendary: It once spun so gently that the whole street yawned at once, and the ice cream van drove home early.

names.legendary: The Guard That Saved Every Tooth

lore.common: Makes its wearer dribble while they talk.
lore.uncommon: Makes everyone sound like they have a lisp.
lore.rare: Saves every tooth from flying balls and elbows.
lore.epic: Was worn by every player in the rugby final, and nobody lost a tooth.
lore.legendary: Saved its owner's teeth for a whole career, and is now in a glass case.

names.legendary: The Dummy That Calmed Every Baby

lore.common: Falls on the floor every time someone stops looking.
lore.uncommon: It hides down the side of the cot at exactly the moment it is needed most.
lore.rare: Calms a crying baby the moment it's popped in.
lore.epic: Was searched for by the whole family at midnight, and was found in the dog's bed.
lore.legendary: Calmed four babies in the same family, one after another.

names.legendary: The Float That Drifted Out to Sea

lore.common: Drifts to the other end of the pool when you look away.
lore.uncommon: Slowly leaks so its rider sinks gently into the water.
lore.rare: It drifts to the deep end on purpose, so whoever is lying on it has to paddle all the way back.
lore.epic: Floated with a fleet of others at the pool party, and the pool disappeared under them.
lore.legendary: Drifted so far on the lake that its rider woke up on the other side.

names.legendary: The Puppet Who Cheered the Grump

lore.common: Is a sock with eyes stuck on, which is surprisingly funny.
lore.uncommon: Talks in a silly voice that everyone pretends not to hear.
lore.rare: Makes the whole room laugh with one wiggle.
lore.epic: Made the whole school laugh at the puppet show, and the headteacher joined in.
lore.legendary: Made the grumpiest man in town laugh for the first time in years.

names.legendary: The Rattle That Made Every Baby Giggle

lore.common: Gets shaken so hard that it flies out of the baby's hand.
lore.uncommon: Gets thrown on the floor to see if someone will pick it up.
lore.rare: Makes every baby giggle with one shake.
lore.epic: Was shaken by every baby at the playgroup at once, and the room sounded like rain.
lore.legendary: Made four generations of babies giggle in the same family.

names.legendary: The Shot That Broke the Record

lore.common: Lands with a thud that dents the grass.
lore.uncommon: Is pushed from the neck, which everyone gets wrong at first.
lore.rare: Flies so far that the officials need a longer tape.
lore.epic: It dropped at sports day with such a thump that the egg-and-spoon eggs all cracked at once.
lore.legendary: Broke the school record that had stood for fifty years.

names.legendary: The Shuttle That Never Fell

lore.common: Crashes feather-first into the net every time.
lore.uncommon: Ends up on the roof after every game.
lore.rare: Floats so slowly that both players have time to chat.
lore.epic: Was hit back and forth in a rally so long that everyone sat down to watch.
lore.legendary: Was hit back and forth for an hour without touching the ground once.

names.legendary: The Spring That Walked Down Every Stair

lore.common: Walks down the stairs on its own and stops at the bottom.
lore.uncommon: Tangles itself into a knot that never comes undone.
lore.rare: Stretches so far across the room that it reaches the door.
lore.epic: Walked down every step in the house in one go, and the family cheered at the bottom.
lore.legendary: Walked down a whole flight of stairs in the town hall without stopping.

names.legendary: The Ball That Flew Over the Fence

lore.common: Is thrown underhand, which everyone forgets.
lore.uncommon: Hides in the mitt so well that the catcher can't find it.
lore.rare: Smacks into the glove with a satisfying pop.
lore.epic: Was hit round the park in a game that lasted until sunset.
lore.legendary: Flew over the fence for the winning home run.

names.legendary: The Block That Launched a Champion

lore.common: Slips back when the runner pushes off.
lore.uncommon: Waits for the starting signal so tensely that everyone holds their breath.
lore.rare: Launches its runner so fast that they leave the others behind.
lore.epic: Launched every runner in the final at exactly the same moment.
lore.legendary: Launched a sprinter to a record that has never been beaten.

names.legendary: The Sticker That Never Came Off

lore.common: Peels off halfway and sticks to itself.
lore.uncommon: Ends up stuck to the wrong place, like the dog.
lore.rare: Goes on the sticker chart and makes every child try harder.
lore.epic: It stuck to the head teacher's back and toured every classroom before lunch without being spotted.
lore.legendary: Was stuck on a lunchbox and stayed there for ten years.

names.legendary: The Ring That Floated Everyone

lore.common: Pinches the armpits of everyone who wears it.
lore.uncommon: Bobs its rider round the pool like a little boat.
lore.rare: Is shaped like a duck that quacks when squeezed.
lore.epic: Floated every child at the pool party, and the pool was full of bobbing ducks.
lore.legendary: Floated a toddler through their very first swim, and the family has kept it ever since.

names.legendary: The Teether That Brought Peace

lore.common: Gets covered in drool within a minute.
lore.uncommon: Is kept in the fridge so it's nice and cold.
lore.rare: Gets chewed so hard that it squeaks.
lore.epic: Was chewed by a teething baby all night, and the whole house finally slept.
lore.legendary: Helped three babies through teething in the same family.

names.legendary: The Soldier Who Stood Guard Forever

lore.common: Stands so still that it never moves, even when the cat walks past.
lore.uncommon: Falls over when someone breathes near it.
lore.rare: Marches in a long line across the shelf.
lore.epic: Paraded across the whole bedroom floor with every soldier in the box.
lore.legendary: Stood guard over the toy box for fifty years without blinking.

names.legendary: The Dummy Who Told Better Jokes

lore.common: Grins in the corner so creepily that the cat won't go near.
lore.uncommon: Clacks its wooden mouth with every word.
lore.rare: Tells jokes that its owner says it thought of.
lore.epic: Stole the show at the talent contest, and the audience laughed until they cried.
lore.legendary: Told jokes so good that the comedian it worked with was a little jealous.
